entities.name: Marcois Jean-Jaquent
entities.description: The vampire baron of Vernot on the island of Luneau, cruel and obsessed with the Arkbow; killed by Vivien's monstrosaur.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who disrupted the coliseum spectacle and bonded to the Arkbow. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Arkbow
entities.description: A mysterious artifact the baron sought to master, which would not obey another hand.

entities.name: Luneau
entities.description: An island on Ixalan where the baron lived.

entities.name: Royal Menagerie
entities.description: Place where creatures were tormented for the elite's entertainment.

entities.name: Monstrosaur
entities.description: A creature from Ixalan tortured by the baron, which Vivien summoned to kill him.

events.summary: At a coliseum spectacle the Baron oversees the torture of animals including a monstrosaur; Vivien tries to intervene.
Vivien disrupts the proceedings with magical creatures; the Baron overpowers and subdues her.
events.quote: Baron Marcois overpowered Vivien, casually removing her daggers from his chest.

events.summary: A guard who tries to use the Arkbow is obliterated, confirming Vivien's claim.
events.quote: When a guard attempted to use the Arkbow, he was obliterated

events.summary: Vivien enlarges a spider and summons the monstrosaur, which wreaks havoc on the ballroom.
events.quote: She then summoned the monstrosaur, which wreaked havoc on the ballroom.

events.summary: The monstrosaur kills the Baron, tearing his body apart.
events.quote: The monstrosaur caught him in its jaws, tearing his body apart

relations.quote: The monstrosaur caught him in its jaws, tearing his body apart

relations.note: He tried to extract the Arkbow's secrets from her.
relations.quote: After numerous attempts to extract the secrets of the Arkbow from Vivien
